You specialize in throwing highly explosive portable ordnances. You become trained with grenades. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.Quick Toss] action.

Special If you have the soldier archetype dedication feat, you can take this feat even if you haven't taken two additional soldier archetype feats. Soldier archetype feats count as grenadier archetype feats, and vice-versa, for purposes of completing the archetypes.
